map.由初始与现存活度求年龄: Find the age from the initial and current activity
map.输入衰变常数 λ、初始核数 N₀ 与现存核数 N，求年龄。: Enter the decay constant λ, the initial number of nuclei N₀ and the current number N to get the age.
map.📖 查看「由初始与现存活度求年龄 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the age from the initial and current activity"
map.t = (1/λ)·ln(N₀/N)。 C-14 减半 → 约 5730 年。: t = (1/λ)·ln(N₀/N). A halving of C-14 gives about 5730 years.
map.C-14 减半 → 约 5730 年。: A halving of C-14 gives about 5730 years.
map.📚 深度解析：由活度比求年代: 📚 Deep Dive: Dating from the activity ratio
map.t = (1/λ)·ln(N₀/N) 由初始/现存核数比反推年代。: t = (1/λ)·ln(N₀/N) infers the age from the initial to current ratio of nuclei.
map.对比不同残留比例的年代。: Compare ages for different remaining fractions.
map.若 N=2.5e19（剩 25%），则 t≈2×5730=11460 年，两个半: If N = 2.5e19 (25% left), then t ≈ 2 x 5730 = 11460 years, two half-lives.
map.这适用于哪些定年？: Which dating methods does this suit?
map.适用于已知 λ 与初始量的封闭体系，如 C-14（λ 对应 5730 年半衰期）: Closed systems with known λ and initial amount, such as C-14 whose λ corresponds to a 5730 year half-life.
map.为什么残留一半就是 th？: Why does half remaining equal th?
map.N/N₀=e^(−λt)=0.5 → t=ln2/λ=th，故半衰期即活度减半所: N/N₀ = e^(-λt) = 0.5 gives t = ln2/λ = th, so the half-life is the time for the activity to halve.
